Example habitat raster

Source: R/data_files.R
hab.Rd

A binary habitat raster stored as hab.tif in the package's extdata folder, used with pts and count_data.

Format

A SpatRaster with one layer, hab, of 400 by 400 cells of 10 map units (an extent of 0 to 4000 in each direction) and no coordinate reference system. Cells are 1 for habitat and 0 otherwise.

Source

Simulated for this package.

See also

pts, count_data.

Examples

hab <- terra::rast(system.file("extdata", "hab.tif",
                               package = "multiScaleR"))
hab
#> class       : SpatRaster
#> size        : 400, 400, 1  (nrow, ncol, nlyr)
#> resolution  : 10, 10  (x, y)
#> extent      : 0, 4000, 0, 4000  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
#> coord. ref. : 
#> source      : hab.tif
#> name        : hab
#> min value   :   0
#> max value   :   1
terra::plot(hab)
